requirements.name: 1 validity
requirements.detail: solids 1, shells 1, closed True, valid True, strict True, faces 6

requirements.name: 1 extent
requirements.detail: projected span (Y) 900.000000 mm vs spec 900.000 (diff -6.48e-11); volume 1208744.496 mm3 (cap adds 44464.635; OCCT default integration gives 1208740.064)

requirements.name: 2 locked outline
requirements.detail: max outermost lip deviation 1.16e-06 mm over 202 cut planes; outline-to-surface max 7.32e-09 mm

requirements.name: 3 joins G1
requirements.detail: 4 edges, 1596 samples: gap 8.07e-12 mm, angle 7.56e-08 deg; curvature mismatch 1.022e-07 /mm (cross-join normal curvature 1.016e-07 /mm); closest sample to an edge end 6.8e-08 mm, 164 samples near collapsed corners not judged

requirements.name: 4 section rule
requirements.detail: 48 cuts (0 failed to trace); thick zone min radius 0.0875469 mm at x/c 0.95 (18 of 20 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 0.03211 at x/c 0.99758219, t 0.05 mm (28 of 28 below 0.9); 42 of the failing cuts cross the lip more than 60 deg from square; bending reversals 150 on 31 cuts

requirements.name: 4b lip-normal radius (informational)
requirements.detail: radius across the lip, perpendicular to the locked outline, at each cut's lip point; thick zone min 0.4695 mm at x/c 0.65 (0 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 1.032 at x/c 0.96544627 (0 below 0.9)

requirements.name: 5 whole-cap map
requirements.detail: worst point radius 0.413266 mm at x/c 0.960383, t 0.8 mm, margin 0.01327 mm; tightest 6.03511e-07 mm at x/c 1; points within 0.05 mm of collapsed corners not judged (grid reaches 4.3e-05 mm; worst there 1.47 mm, score 48.2)

requirements.name: 6 TE closure
requirements.detail: sharp point; right (+Y): closes True, 0.02 mm before TE: t 0.00436, section min R 1.99e-05, ratio 0.0091; principal R within 0.1 mm of the TE point min 1.017; left (-Y): closes True, 0.02 mm before TE: t 0.00436, section min R 1.99e-05, ratio 0.0091; principal R within 0.1 mm of the TE point min 0.9065
